items.label: DIRECT ANSWER
items.text: I find it difficult to maintain every friendship.

items.label: REASON
items.text: As people get busier, their schedules become harder to match.

items.label: PERSONAL DETAIL

Follow-up questions · Stay on the topic

conversations.title: An unexpected message
conversations.target: drift apart · reach out · catch up
conversations.lift: pick up where we left off
conversations.question: Read or listen. What changed between Maya and Sophie?

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: You look surprised. Is everything okay?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Yes. I just got a message from Sophie, an old university friend.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: I don't think you've mentioned her before. Were you close?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Very close. We used to spend nearly every weekend together.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: What happened? Did you have an argument?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: No. We moved to different cities and gradually drifted apart.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: So why did she message you now?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: She found an old photo of us and decided to reach out.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: That's nice. Are you going to get back in touch properly?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Definitely. We're planning a video call this weekend so we can catch up.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.text: Do you think it'll feel awkward after so long?

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Maybe at first, but I think we'll quickly pick up where we left off.

check: Why did Maya and Sophie drift apart?
Would you reply if an old friend contacted you? Why?
What would you want to ask them first?
conversations.answers: different cities · reach out / get back in touch · catch up
conversations.note: Đọc lời thoại trước khi xem slide. Học viên nghe để tìm mối quan hệ và lý do họ xa cách. Sau đó xác định 3 câu hỏi nối tiếp, đọc theo vai, đổi vai và lặp lại không nhìn từng dòng.

conversations.title: Busy lives
conversations.target: have a lot going on · stay connected
conversations.question: Read or listen. Is the friendship still important to both speakers?

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: You and Carla used to be really close. Do you still talk?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: We do, but not as often as before. We both have a lot going on.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Is it mainly work, or have your lives just changed?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: A bit of both. She has two young children, and my job has become busier.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Does it bother you that you don't speak regularly?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Sometimes. I miss our long conversations, especially when I need advice.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Have you told her that?

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: Not directly. I know she's busy, so I don't want to make her feel guilty.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Maybe you could suggest something simple, like a monthly call.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: That might work. It would help us stay connected without adding pressure.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Exactly. Good friendships still need time, even when life gets busy.

lines.speaker: Nora
lines.text: You're right. I'll reach out tonight and see when she's free.

check: have a lot going on — nghĩa là gì?
make someone feel guilty — nghĩa là gì?
without adding pressure — nghĩa là gì?
reach out tonight — nghĩa là gì?
conversations.answers: be very busy with several things · cause someone to feel responsible or bad · without making the situation more stressful · continue having contact · contact the person tonight
conversations.note: Lần nghe 1: quyết định xem tình bạn còn quan trọng không. Lần 2: tìm 2 lý do họ ít nói chuyện hơn. Chú ý Nora trả lời cân bằng thay vì đổ lỗi cho bạn.

speaking.text: What is a realistic way for busy friends to stay connected?
Trả lời ít nhất 45 giây. Dùng 1 cụm từ từ phần từ vựng.

roleplay.title: An unexpected reunion
roleplay.context: You unexpectedly meet an old friend at a café after five years.
steps: A: React and ask what your friend has been doing.
B: Share two life changes and ask about A.
A: Explain why you lost touch without blaming anyone.
B: Suggest a realistic way to get back in touch.
BOTH: Agree on a next step and end naturally.
roleplay.useful: used to · drift apart · get back in touch · catch up · stay connected

roleplay.title: A busy friend
roleplay.context: You want more contact, but your friend has a lot going on.
steps: YOU: Explain how you feel without sounding accusatory.
FRIEND: Explain what has made life busy.
YOU: Suggest one simple way to stay connected.
FRIEND: Respond honestly and offer another option.
BOTH: Choose a plan that feels realistic.
roleplay.useful: I know you've been busy, but… · I don't want to add pressure. · Would it work if…?

roleplay.text: Lượt 1 chạy có gợi ý. Lượt 2 che slide và đổi 1 chi tiết. Chỉ khuyến khích lượt 3–5 câu khi nội dung thực sự cần. Model chỉ 1 câu mở đầu, để học viên tự thương lượng phần còn lại.
